features:
Key Features:

Made from 100% whole grain oats

Certified gluten-free, carefully processed to avoid cross-contamination

Low in sugar – about 1 gram per serving

No artificial flavors or colors

Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals such as iron, calcium, vitamin D, and B vitamins

Naturally cholesterol-free and low in fat

Contains about 3 grams of dietary fiber per serving

Benefits:

Safe for gluten-sensitive and celiac individuals

Supports heart health thanks to soluble fiber and low saturated fat

Promotes digestive health with a decent fiber content

Provides a nutrient-dense breakfast or snack, especially for kids and seniors

Convenient and versatile – great with milk, yogurt, or even as a dry snack
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Starch, Sugar, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
